title: Homemade Beef & Lamb Gyros Hack
one_liner: Use a parchment paper rolling hack to make authentic-style gyros at home without a spit.
key_points: Mix ground chuck steak and lamb with grated onion, oregano, garlic, paprika, and cumin, roll to ¼-inch thick, and bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes
Tzatziki is made with grated cucumber (moisture squeezed out), Greek yogurt, red wine vinegar, lemon zest, oregano, and fresh dill — best made a day ahead
Let the meat rest 8 minutes after baking for maximum juiciness before slicing
Assemble in warmed pita with caramelized onion, tomatoes, Greek feta, parsley, and olive oil

ingredients: warmed pita, caramelized onion, tomatoes, Greek feta, parsley for serving
instructions: 1. Grind chuck steak and lamb together. Mix with grated onion, oregano, garlic, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
2. Place mixture on parchment paper, cover with another sheet, and roll out to ¼-inch thick.
3. Drizzle with Greek olive oil and bake at 400°F for 20–25 minutes. Rest 8 minutes before slicing.
4. For tzatziki: combine grated garlic, red wine vinegar, lemon zest, squeezed cucumber, oregano, salt, pepper, Greek yogurt, and a little fresh dill. Refrigerate until ready to use.
5. Assemble gyros in warmed pita with meat, caramelized onion, tomatoes, feta, parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil.
